## Pull request overview

Implements a Fumadocs multi-section navigation pattern to split documentation into three top-level sections (Guide, Components, Ecosystem) and reduce sidebar size by scoping navigation to the active section.

**Changes:**
- Updated the docs site top navigation to include Guide / Components / Ecosystem links.
- Reorganized the `docs/` content tree into sectioned folders with new `meta.json` files to drive scoped sidebars.
- Added/expanded Guide reference material (API + protocol) and Ecosystem content (plugins + examples).

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 52 out of 63 changed files in this pull request and generated 9 comments.

This `BaseSchema` example uses `React.CSSProperties`, which contradicts the “zero React dependencies” goal for `@object-ui/core`/`@object-ui/types` and doesn’t match the actual type (`style?: Record<string, string | number>` in `packages/types/src/base.ts`). Please update the example to avoid React types here.

`@object-ui/components` doesn’t currently export `registerDefaultRenderers()` (it exports `initializeComponents()` and registers renderers via side effects). Please update this snippet to match the actual initialization API, otherwise readers will hit runtime/import errors.

These relative links (e.g. `../components/layout.md`) resolve under `docs/guide/reference/components/*`, which doesn’t exist. Please link to the real component docs under `/docs/components/...` (or adjust the directory structure accordingly).

These plugin links use `../plugins/...`, which resolves to `docs/guide/plugins/*` (a directory that doesn’t exist in this repo). Please update them to the actual plugin docs location (e.g. `/docs/ecosystem/plugins/...`) so they don’t 404.

This example imports schema types from `@object-ui/core`, but in the current repo those schema types live in `@object-ui/types` (and `@object-ui/core` doesn’t re-export them). Please update the import path (or add re-exports if that’s the intended API).

This section says the `DataSource` interface is defined in `@object-ui/core`, but in the repo it’s defined in `@object-ui/types` (`packages/types/src/data.ts`) and the method signatures differ (e.g. `find()` returns `QueryResult`). Please update this description/snippet to match the actual interface.

These protocol links use absolute paths like `/protocol/view`, but the docs baseUrl is `/docs` (see `apps/site/lib/source.ts`). They should be updated to `/docs/guide/reference/protocol/...` (or made relative) so they resolve within the docs app.

This page links to `/docs/plugins/...`, which routes to the legacy Plugins section instead of keeping users within the new Ecosystem section (`/docs/ecosystem/plugins/...`). To preserve the multi-section sidebar behavior, update these links to `/docs/ecosystem/plugins/...` (or use relative links).

`useSchemaContext` (and the related hooks/providers documented below) are not currently exported by `@object-ui/react` (the `packages/react/src/hooks` and `context` exports are empty). Please either implement/export these APIs or update this page to match the actual public API.
